title: 3 World Trade Center
visualBrief: Completed RSHP tower with three unequal glazed planes, external stainless-steel K braces, eight corner offices, three landscaped terraces and the skew Greenwich Street cable-net lobby.

nativeAxes.front: -X toward Greenwich Street and the memorial

sourceFacts.cladding: Glass curtain wall and stainless-steel-clad external corner K bracing

reconstruction.plan: The exact ground foot and four independently mapped component outlines retain the tower location and separate western podium. The architect published typical floor plan resolves the incomplete/overlapping raw shoulder traces into three connected rectangular planes with four reentrant corner zones. Northern shoulder is higher than southern.
reconstruction.facade: Continuous glazing and planar mullion/transom/spandrel strips preserve published5ft/10ft module datums; volumetric stainless corner columns and K braces remain, with flat louver strips instead of shells.
reconstruction.terraces: Three primary published terrace elevations have separate decks, glass guards, planters and simple benches. The sixty-foot skew western lobby has modeled cable-net nodes and revolving-door enclosures.

limitations: The unchanged original build3Wtc recipe reproduces295672triangles/29241552bytes exactly. Reviewed source preserves the independent skew podium, three connected cruciform planes with unequal northern/southern terraces, four projecting stainless K-frame zones at original cadence, full-height central corner columns, tower/podium facade datums, closed mechanical crown, all three terrace decks with glass guards, planted gardens, reconstructed benches, GreenwichStreet cable-net lobby and three revolving door enclosures. Continuous glass walls, flat mullion/transom/spandrel strips and flat crown-louver strips replace repeated pane cells and section shells. Tiny cover-joint seams are omitted. Shared stainless and granite graphs serve two reusable textures; vegetation shares granite with green vertex tint as a deliberate coarse surface approximation, and tinted stainless approximates painted roof/bench finishes. Glass/recess use one opaque vision-glass palette; door glass retains a separate translucent palette, four near draw groups total. Skyline retains stepped envelope, flattened two-sided K-brace ribbons at original cadence, roof decks and guards, sparse40-floor facade bands and unframed mechanical recesses; it omits facade mullions, entrance hardware, planters/benches and roof equipment. District restores four-floor bands, coarse vertical mullions, two-sided flattened braces and three low-sided door casings, omitting K connection nodes, cable-net tubes, garden furniture and rooftop equipment. Street restores all facade floor datums, sparse glass guard posts, brace plates, coarse vegetation and rooftop boxes with20-sided door glass; near adds published5ft/10ft module framing, dense louvers/guards/plants, cable-net nodes,36-sided doors and rooftop grilles. Upper part regularization, exact facade phase, intermediate mechanical/lobby panel datums, K-brace spacing/section, roof service equipment, terrace furnishings and entry hardware remain photo reconstructions. Architect rounded330m height differs from selected owner1079ft/328.8792m. Physical-device/dense-city timings and surveyed curb/entry fit remain unmeasured.
